findings.name: all_cash_writes_nothing
findings.detail: the observe phase logs and grades non-cash targets; it only declines to apply them. A dry run of MYX:5183=0.12 would have written 1 target and logged prediction paper-2026-09-10-myx5183-21d-e215 grading 2026-10-10. So the empty ledger after three observe nights is entirely due to all-cash writing no row, not to the phase.

findings.name: genting_evidence_points_away
findings.detail: S&P fallen-angel flag (09-08, 09-09), Fitch soft 2026 earnings (09-08), a third outlet on downgrade risk (09-09). Long-only book, so coherent negative evidence produces no position.

mistakes: The 2026-09-08 and 2026-09-09 pages framed the empty ledger as a property of the observe phase. It is not: a dry run tonight showed a non-cash target would be recorded and would log a gradeable prediction. The cause is all-cash writing no row.
Carried three nights: ask.py paper decide prints 'this is logged and will be graded' on an input where nothing is logged and nothing can be graded.
lessons: A phase that logs but does not apply still needs something to log; a book that only ever decides nothing cannot be told apart from a book that is broken.
Price without evidence is not a thesis, however large the move; the book's best performer is also the one name with an empty store, and those facts are related through the collector, not the company.
When an instrument's behaviour is attributed to a rule, check the rule.
